title: Orbit and Signal Anew
author: Felix Brightwater
blurb: Ivo Villalobos, the last human technician on an automated relay station, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
